text: The Comet Cup. Welcome, race fans! I'm Zip Zoomer, and this is the Comet Cup, the fastest race in the galaxy! And you, captain, are on the starting line!
The rules. Fly from the start line, past the checkpoint, to the finish line on one tank of fuel. Refuel and you go back to the start. Plan your jumps!
Three, two, one. Fill your tank right to the top, captain. Engines roaring, crowd cheering. Three, two, one... go, go, go!
Across the line! And they're over the finish line! What a race! What a pilot! The whole crowd is on its feet, captain!
Champion. The Comet Cup is yours, champion! Polish it every day, and come back next season to defend your title!
